data.answer: Patent filings by small and medium enterprises (SMEs) grew by **27% in 2021**. SMEs also reached a decadal high of **68% of organisational patent applicants with Australian operations**, with their share rising 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.[1]

citations.quote: Focusing only on organisational applicants with Australian operations, 68% are small and medium enterprise (SMEs) and 23% are large entities. In 2021, SME filings grew 27% and the SME share of organisational applicants has reached a decadal high, rising 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.

claims.text: In 2021, SME patent filings grew 27%, and SMEs accounted for a decadal-high 68% of organisational patent applicants with Australian operations; their share rose 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.
